req.title: Reject player with duplicate squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when the squadNumber in a new player already belongs to another player.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-008 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when a POST /players/ request carries a squadNumber already owned by an existing player. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a genuinely new squadNumber is accepted with HTTP 201; (2) a negative/EP case confirming an exact duplicate squadNumber returns HTTP 409 with the correct detail message; (3) a boundary/BVA case using the lowest pre-loaded squadNumber (1) to confirm the conflict is detected at the boundary of the roster; (4) a boundary/BVA case confirming squadNumber 27 (one above the highest pre-loaded value) is accepted; (5) a negative/DT case combining a duplicate squadNumber with otherwise-different player data to confirm the conflict check is solely on squadNumber; (6) a boundary/BVA case at the upper boundary (squadNumber=26); (7) a negative/NEG case confirming that after a 409 the conflicting player was NOT persisted. The violation fix: test[6] was kind=negative with heuristic=STC, which is invalid (STC is only valid for positive kind). It is now changed to heuristic=NEG to match its negative kind.

tests.name: test_post_player_new_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squadNumbers 1-26
squadNumber 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squadNumber=99
expected: Response body contains the created player with squadNumber=99
Response body contains a valid UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-008: system shall accept a player whose squadNumber is not already taken
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

payload = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "squadNumber": 99,
    "position": "Goalkeeper"
}
r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
assert r.status_code == 201
body = r.json()
assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
assert "id" in body
assert len(body["id"]) == 36

tests.name: test_post_player_conflict_does_not_create_player
preconditions: Database contains a player with squadNumber=5 (Vivaan Nair)
GET /players/ returns the pre-loaded roster before the test
actions: Record the total player count via GET /players/
expected: Player count after the failed POST is identical to the count before
No new player with squadNumber=5 appears in the roster beyond the original
trace: R-PLAYER-008: a rejected duplicate must not be persisted; the roster must remain unchanged after a 409 response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

before = client.get("/players/")
assert before.status_code == 200
count_before = len(before.json())

payload = {
    "firstName": "Ghost",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "squadNumber": 5,
    "position": "Striker"
}
r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
assert r.status_code == 409
assert r.json()["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

after = client.get("/players/")
assert after.status_code == 200
count_after = len(after.json())
assert count_after == count_before

players_with_5 = [p for p in after.json() if p["squadNumber"] == 5]
assert len(players_with_5) == 1
assert players_with_5[0]["firstName"] != "Ghost"
